title: From Parameter Rebasin to Functional Transfer Across Heterogeneous Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adapting pretrained Transformers to downstream tasks produces task-specific updates that are expensive to reproduce for every model variant. Reusing these updates across different depths and widths is challenging because their parameters have incompatible shapes and do not share a canonical coordinate system. We introduce Ariadne, a training-free method that transfers task-specific behavior across heterogeneous Transformers without resizing the source model or transporting its parameters. Rather than treating the source task vector, i.e. the difference in parameter space between the fine-tuned and the base models, as the object to move, Ariadne characterizes fine-tuning by the activation changes it induces at matched blocks. First, it aligns these effects to a target base through local Procrustes maps. Then, it directly synthesizes a native target update by closed-form ridge regression. translated_title: 从参数重定位到异构Transformer间的功能迁移
translated_abstract: 将预训练的Transformer适配到下游任务会产生特定于任务的更新，而针对每个模型变体重新生成这些更新的成本很高。在不同深度和宽度的模型之间复用这些更新非常困难，因为它们的参数形状互不兼容，且不共享统一的坐标系。我们提出了Ariadne，这是一种免训练的方法，能够在异构Transformer之间迁移任务特定的行为，而无需调整源模型的尺寸或传输其参数。Ariadne不再把源任务向量（即微调模型与基础模型在参数空间中的差异）视为需要移动的对象，而是通过微调在匹配的网络块处引起的激活变化来刻画微调行为。首先，它通过局部Procrustes映射将这些效应与目标基础模型对齐；随后，利用闭式岭回归直接合成目标模型的原生更新。在Transformer扩展、缩减和语言（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出免训练方法Ariadne，通过刻画匹配块处的激活变化并用局部Procrustes映射对齐、闭式岭回归直接合成目标更新，在异构Transformer之间实现无需移动参数的任务行为迁移。
en_tdlr: Ariadne is a training-free method that transfers task-specific behavior across heterogeneous Transformers by characterizing fine-tuning via activation changes at matched blocks, aligning them with local Procrustes maps, and synthesizing a native target update through closed-form ridge regression—without moving parameters.
